notes.title: Free city update progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I wanted to update you all on a development progress of Free City update 0.3, and share a little more info about what's going to be in the city. 



Right now we are completed basic scripting and character work for most major quests in the city, and finished level design for about a third of the level. Let's take a look at some of city districts that are more or less finished with props and models. They arent populated with citizens yet, so keep this in mind:


Slums
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/f6530668e9f5d68089e59d2bae57d8a1363abb54.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/3bb7de7106458528e4fe3c97206f71ff99283edd.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/2ba3e1fa06ac14fcc231213acc8d6e7e9774c7ff.jpg"]

The poorest distric in the city. A chaotic jumble of flimsy wooden buildings filled with dirt, beggars and stench. Even if you somehow end up there, you won't find anything but trouble, adventure, and encounters with bandits. At the center of the slums there is city prison, the one where our prisoner origin players escaped from:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/66659d36450ba155b336b62fd52a52933b8e103c.jpg"]


Industrial alley
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/fc1c0cf1a627eb226ec613703b28498ad93fb6b5.jpg"] 

The industrial alley is a small cluster of workshops, warehouses, and workers. The place is filled with smoke from furnaces, the clanging of hammers, and the shouts of crafters. Players can come here to learn new skills and talk about crafting.


Mage academy 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/89e1b2acf8fddc23b7e5a38278644e422d8685ce.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/56b18d5123ea3ea45a548c94b54b1246e67423b4.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/12fe173993f45545d826134bfae400ef1f2f1c4d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/bbbcf77643653a19b631115990539cca68fc0a56.jpg"]

The main mage academy of Free City. This is where all the best mages in Esnon study the secrets of magic. Players learning magic can come here and take a few lessons from local professors. It also houses the largest library in Esnon.


Cathedral of Light
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/e27455bc9817bceb5f9a7e76d04e900425f7e699.jpg"]A place where priests and paladins worship the light, help the suffering, and guide the lost onto the path of righteousness.



There will be much more in the city, which I will show in later progress reports. The city will also have a city market, a council hall, a wealthy neighborhood, a port, a city cemetery, etc. 


Crime system


We are also planning a crime system for the Free city. If you attack citizens, commit crimes or steal, you will increase your infamy level, which, after certain amount, will make city guard attack you on sight and close all merchants except shady ones for interaction. Biggest infamy levels will cause elite guards to constanly attack you at all times, making it very hard to even be in the city without stealth. You will need to go the city prison and pay a fine, to restore your infamy level to default numbers.



A pickpocket skill will be added in banditry, allowing you to pickpocket every NPC with a risk of triggering him and increasing your infamy.


Sewer system
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/b1ebffdfa9345b23299e8093e0b720b567e536a8.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/a398d96601d0cae28672d8117618bd1a92837a4a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/fc53320fbf883716a843a7668d89ac6ae4868e6a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/7c00a40a3dbcf0f666b83c2ce49ca99b9687f560.jpg"]

Underneath a city players will find a huge interconnected system of ancient tunnels hundreds years old. Its a huge dungeon area, in which you will find monsters, bandits, secret society bases, powerful bosses and other stuff. This will be a huge place to explore and find something cool, and a lot of quests will lead you there.


Other stuff that will be in the update:


Level cap increased to 24

8 secondary quests, varying from large and complex to simple ones

dozens of different story mettings and interactions, quests and mysteries

New equipment, new recipes for crafting

You will be able to buy armor for your dog companion

And much, much more


When will all this come out?
We are aiming to release the update this autumn. October is a more realistic release window, but November is also possible. We are trying to make the content as polished as possible, so we will take as much time as we can.

Husbandry probably wont be included in this content update, it will be a part of the next update right after this one.



Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 0.25.10
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The game was updated with version 0.25.10
UI updates


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/5553c293f1be283475c36cc34ca95c0f80299c3f.jpg"]

For the past couple of weeks we've been working hard on improving UI experience. It's a slow and difficult process, which involves a lot of small details, that's why progress was a little slower than usual. We've updated most of the game UI elements, the biggest one ofcourse is Skill menu, which now has all the abilities on one window, without needeng to open a bunch of sub-menus. This will hopefully improve character building experience overall. We will continue improving UI in future updates, based on your feedback.


New abilities
New ability for Storm magic: Blizzard

New ability for Storm magic: Weather master

New ability for Storm magic: Focused thunderstrike

New ability for Earth magic: Tremorlings

New ability for nature magic: Titanroot strike

New ability for Archery: Focused aim

New passive improvements for most magic skill trees

Magical strike is temporary removed from the game, and will be replaced with more powerful version later


Other changes and fixes
I've decided to remove randomized melee combos. While originally it was intended to provide variety for melee combat, which it did, especially at lower levels, it's still irritating and less reliable for some players, who like to always predict the way their character attacks. So I left only one type of melee combo for each weapon, which would hopefully make combat more predictable and easier to master.

You can now create a sleeping bag in adddition to the camping fire, to sleep while traveling

Farming spots now correctly remove resources, when you clear them

World events require less objectives, depending on difficulty, which should make them less grindy on higher difficulties

Fixed the bug where one waypoint wasn't teleporting to the second zone properly


Free city and future updates progress
We are working hard on the big Free City Update, and I wanted to share some of the stuff we've made:



New cloak designs

Thank you for your support!   Check out my youtube channel (I might post previews of new updates there, or might not):   Check out our social media links:

notes.title: Update 0.24.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am very excited to announce that the game was updated with version 0.24a! 

This is a huge content update, which I've been tirelessly working on for the past 3 weeks. It adds atleast two hours of content for one playthrough and brings a lot of changes and improvements to the game. Please remember that new dialogue lack voice over at the moment, because it's still being recorded.

Faction war on Tranquil Strand

Now you can particpate in a war between three factions: Fishermen, Lazarian and Pirates. Joining each faction will give you unique rewards and new content to complete. The Lazarian Temple is now submerged by default, and you will need to raise it from the ocean to enter it. This was always the original intention, but I've just left it open to give players some difficult content to complete, while faction wars were being finished. 

Fishermen:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/79a6fca7e1d2b64e228f930131dbc2d6994d5ac6.jpg
To join this faction, talk to the Elder Wally near the entrance to Aramoore, and you will be able to defeat Lazarian and make the coast safe for Fishermen, and allow mage academy to research the Lazarian temple, and also you will participate in Fishermen Festival quest.


Lazarian:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/1277ec492ff28269bfa5daed1704b40427c9489b.jpg

To join this faction, look for a shark on the beach not far away from the temple. After you join the faction, you will be able to help Lazarian completely destroy all opposing factions and gain full control over the zone. This will allow you to gain access to new improved Lazarian buildings and get a quest to recruit a unique Lazarian companion.

Pirates:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/6b680f56742bf704bc58dcbec370723e6d7324d6.jpg
To join this faction, you will have to talk to the pirate Kirk on the beach, the one you talked with for Pirate's Code quest. After joining this faction you will be able to asault other factions in the zone, and even visit new unique pirate town called Skaldebra and complete quest there.

Willsborough fort
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/70208d92aaa780a4c1a50cd45b0b38d5eaf561b0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/846ddfea4308a0d1e9e8c775360a6b7e7990cf0c.jpg
You will now be able to help rangers of the Golden Lion to clear the old fort from th bandits and explore depths of the dungeon, hidden underneath it. After clearing the dungeon you will be able to rebuild the forst and gain access to unique set of armor from rangers.

Gameplay changes


 All companions wont' collide with player models anymore
 Fixed quest Dog's honor for rebel faction
 Added coral spawns in the second zone
 Posions now correctly apply to bows
 Added fish spots in the water, which should improve your fishing chances
 Reduce knock resistance for the games in the goblins siege event


Balance changes:


 I've dramatically reworked rage mechanics for Melee. Now, instead of being a stackable effect, rage has it's own bar and has 3 stages of effectiveness. Powerful melee abilities like annihilation now don't consume rage, but instead decrease cooldown, depending on the current amount of rage you have. New powerful passive abilities added that depend on amount of rage. Killing Frenzy was is reworked completely. all these changes now give huge survivability for warriors and allow to defeat enemies on higher difficulity quite effectively
 New passives for grappling hook abilities
 You can now activate flying in mid-air
 New passive for acrobatics in archery
 Shield of wind now correctly blocks projectiles
 Stealth now applies cooldown upon exiting, instead of entering stealth
 Bosses now have better chances to see player in stealth
 Shocking song now stuns enemies and overall is more powerful
 Striking notes damage increased
 New passive for bard attacks that allows to get chords with attacking enemies
 New abilities for music skill tree
 New powerful golem for nature skill tree


I've also fixed a lot of smaller bugs and issues.

What's next?

I am planning to take a little break, because I never really had one for the past 8 months, preparing for release, fixing the game after and working on this update. After that I plan to start working on the Free City update, Shapeshifting and Husbandry skill trees. Ofcourse there will be small updates with changes and improvements, while we work on a big Free City Update.

Here are the first concept arts for the citizens of Free City and also First look on 4 out of 6 Shapeshifting forms we plan to implement.

notes.title: Update 0.24 preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are working hard on a new big version 0.24 and I wanted to share a little more info about it. 

Faction war

The update will be all about faction war in the second zone between fishermen village, Lazarian and Pirates. You will be able to join any of the faction and support them in their war against other factions. After destroying a faction you will be able to get new unique loot, new companions and quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/4a840a2013a9708ad85120a344c3ab480810ce67.jpg

When it's coming out? I plan to finish it at the end of May- beginning of June. 


New abilities

I also want to add new highest tier abilities for some skill trees, to finalize their playstyle for the foreseeable future. Some of the mechanics will be reworked, for example I have plans to dramatically rework rage mechanic for Melee to improve survivability and effectiveness of this playstyle. 

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 0.22.10
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The game was just updated with version 0.22.10

New content

New secondary quest.

New secondary quest was added to the game, called Heart of the Stone. It's a small and simple quest that was originally meant for Earth Elemental crusher boss in the second zone, but werent able to put it in at the time. Now it can be completed, even though the voice over is still in development. It's not marked on the map, but you can find it near the coast and the gorge with stone elementals near the western end of the map.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588472/d35c3dcd99ff4476aa833ed701815530346c2119.png
Limited time event.

We are very proud to participate in Games From Russia festival on steam, and in honor of that, from May 1st to 9th, you will be able to enter a portal into the small valley of Northern Kingdoms and fight a terrifying Demon of North! You can find a portal near Volflar Temple in the first zone


Balance and gameplay changes

I've finally had some time to address some balance and gameplay issues and improve some of the abilities. I will continue to improve and add more abilities all through May.

General:


 Torch reworked into lantern, which doesnt influence your animation anymore and looks better
 Reworked merchant prices values a little to prevent gaining some of them with crafting easily
 Added new difficulty setting - nightmare. Difficulty settings now also influence damage enemies receive, in addition to the damage player receive. You can now change difficulty of your worlds at any time from the worlds list
 Reduced overall mana regen bonus a little more. I think mana regen is in a good state at this point, which is you won't need to constantly drink after each smaller and easier encounter in the world, but some of the harder fights will drain your mana after some time
 Projectiles from staves now have auto-aim that should help with hitting enemies
 Aggro calculation reworked, now you will generate a little more aggro from longer distance


Melee: 


 Increased axe swings speed by about 10%
 Reduced jump landing damage by about 15%. Jump is already fantastic positioning. movement and stagger ability, so I didn't wanted it to become a primary damage ability also
 Improved ultimate melee abilities. Annihilation now gives invincibility while performing, Deadly combo doesnt require rage anymore and also gives invincibility, WAves of power, earth and sword of fire perform much faster
 Constant whirlwind speed slightly reduced


Archery:


 Increased amounts of powerful arrows made by arrows crafting
 Rain of arrows Wave- reduced stamina price to 5 instead of 25, also it will now rotate you in the direction of the camera


Banditry:


 Posions now have maximum cap of stacks. Daggers can apply 8 poisons max, other weapons range from 4 to 5
 Vindictive shadow doesnt require stamina anymore
 Added more powerful bombs in bandit crafting
 Added two new abilities: Shadow dash and Hard to Hit


Storm magic:


 Lightning strike damage reduced by about 15%
 Tornado lifetime reduced from 120 seconds to 20 seconds. This was neccessary change because original tornado just made enemies static for too long
 Added new passives that imrpove electromagnetic shield


Earth magic:


 Earth spikes and magma ball abilities damage increased by about 20%
 Meteor damage reduced by about 15%
 Stone skin gives more defense based on your conjuring magic stat and less based on your player level, which shoul make it more useful for mage builds and less for warrior builds
 Fire damage over time now scales better with dot damage stat, perhaps it will be increased more after more testing


Nature magic:


 Thorn throwing abilities and root strike ability damage increased by about 20%


Dark magic:


 All minions's damage get more bonus from minions power stat


Companion builds:


 Musical defense gives overall more absorb amount
 Fixed the bug where defense was calculated incorrectly for companions, whcih led to some heavy geared companions not receiving any damage. This now works correctly



Bug fixes:


 Fixed the bug where some items were replaced on the action bar after reloading
 Fixed few bugs with positioning in house building mode
 Block with magical defense now correctly blocks magical attacks
 Fixed the visual bug with jump pads in multiplayer
 Fixed few bugs with tooltips and DLSS visual bugs
 Fixed few issues with collisions in the second zone
 Fixed the bug with being stuck in aiming while using master archer mode


Gamepad support:

 You can now control interface cursor with DPad
 Fixed few small issues with windows not behaving correctly


Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch 0.21.43
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am continuing working hard on fixing all the issues you post. I wanted to thank you all for your positive and even negative feedback, because it helps the game to grow even more.

Bug fixes:


 Grizelle in human form will now correctly disables after giving player a reward

 Fixed the bug when vehicle use stopped staffs recharging

 Applied a fix that should correctly disable stealthed models in multiplayer

 Fixed some enemies in arena mode not spawning

 Fixed problems with bandits animations in Dog's honor mode
 Fixed vindictive shadow ability causing errors
 Fixed visual bug with password window clipping with games list in lobby
 Fixed diversion event for goblins
 Fixed issue with multiple players using a vehicle at the same time


Companions AI improvements:

 Companions projectiles now wont collide with allies
 Companions will try to teleport to their destination when stuck in terrain
 Companions will better react to player's enemies attacking
 Improved pathfinding precision with companions


Combat improvements.

While I am focusing at the moment mostly on fixing critical bugs, I'm also trying to improve on game feel a little bit too, based on your feedback. Hopefull I'll be able to focus on it more next week.


 Slightly improved dodge roll speed and distance
 Slightly imrpoved base attack speed for low agility characters. I still don't want them to feel as fast in combat as high agility characters, but this should improve the feel of the combat
 Improved collision for melee weapons, now you have more chances to hit your target.



Crafting changes:

Based on a lot of feedback from the players, especially multiplayer, I've decided that current intellect requirements don't really work for crafting. Now every character can craft anything with any amount of intellect. I still want the intellect to give some sort of bonus for intellect inc rafting, so now higher intellect slightly improves chances of increasing crafting skill while crafting. It's not a huge difference, but it should give some advantages in the long run and works for roleplaying. 

I've also added a crafting window at the upper bar, that shows current masteries of different crafts of your character.


What's next?

As I mentioned before, stability right now is the priority. I'm aware of the issues with muiltiplayer, and we are working hard on finding and solving them. After that we will focus on improving gameplay feel, and adding some missing features like potion of oblivion for respec and other useful staff. 

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Last development blog before game release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been out of touch for quite a while. This is because, over the last six months, we’ve been actively working on story-related content and didn’t want to spoil anything.

At this point, we’ve practically finished all the content planned for the Early Access launch and are busy finalizing all the functionality—namely crafting, the skill system, construction, multiplayer stability, and more. Our current target date for Early Access is March 24. We’ll do our best to choose the most suitable date to avoid clashing with major releases and to ensure the game is in the best possible condition for Early Access. The game will include two fully completed initial zones and a partially completed major first city—providing at least 8–10 hours of content in a single playthrough.

Participation in Next Fest

As many of you may know, our demo took part in the Steam festival back in October. Overall, we’re pleased with the feedback from players, and we received a lot of useful input. The main points were:

[olist]
 Better optimization
 Improved character responsiveness
 Overhauling the skill system
[/olist]

We’ve taken this feedback into account and are actively working on fixing these issues. In the Early Access version, you’ll be able to use all skill variations simultaneously. This has unlocked the potential for a huge variety of builds, and we’re currently focusing on skill balance.

Participation in Igroprom, RED Expo

This fall, we also had the chance to take part in major Russian conventions—Igroprom and RED Expo. It was great to chat in person with fans, see them play the demo, and hear their opinions. Additionally, the first Gedonia was awarded Best Russian RPG.

Early Access Release

This post is the last development blog we’re planning before the Early Access launch. We’re all eagerly awaiting March 24, when we can finally let you play the game. Thank you for your attention, and happy holidays!
